# Copilot Instructions

This repository is an OpenAPI-first SSH control plane for AI agents and Linux VPS automation.

Before making changes:

- read [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)
- use [`../SSH_API_GUIDE.md`](../SSH_API_GUIDE.md) for API workflow context
- run `python scripts/verify.py` after meaningful changes
- never commit `config.json` or real credentials

The main project instructions live in [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).
